rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); canvas-kernel: Canvas gains set_font_smoothing(FontSmoothing), canvas state scoped by save()/restore() like the clip and matrix. SkiaCanvas shapes and measures antialiased text with run hinting off (TextStyle::setFontHinting, and the glyph-fallback SkFont), and keeps unhinted runs out of SkParagraph's paragraph cache, whose key ignores hinting, with an inert OpenType feature tag; RecordingCanvas records it as a draw command. With the chromium text raster policy this reproduces Chromium's -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased glyphs; text that never sets it is byte-identical. No surface, render or authority boundary moves. Vellum inherits per-draw font smoothing with the canvas kernel.
